001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.currentStatus.CgmStatusV2Response;
007
008import java.util.Set;
009import java.util.TreeSet;
010
011@HistoryLogProps(
012    opCode = 256,
013    displayName = "Dexcom G6 CGM Data",
014    internalName = "LID_CGM_DATA_GXB",
015    usedByAndroid = true,
016    usedByTidepool = true, // LID_CGM_DATA_GXB
017    usedByTconnectsync = true
018)
019public class DexcomG6CGMHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
020    
021    private int glucoseValueStatusRaw;
022    private GlucoseValueStatus glucoseValueStatus;
023    private int cgmDataTypeRaw;
024    private Set<CgmDataType> cgmDataTypes;
025    private int rate;
026    private int algorithmState;
027    private int rssi;
028    private int currentGlucoseDisplayValue;
029    private long timeStampSeconds;
030    private int egvInfoBitmaskRaw;
031    private Set<EgvInfo> egvInfo;
032    private int interval;
033    private int egvCount;
034    
035    public DexcomG6CGMHistoryLog() {}
036    
037    public DexcomG6CGMHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int glucoseValueStatusRaw, int cgmDataTypeRaw, int rate, int algorithmState, int rssi, int currentGlucoseDisplayValue, long timeStampSeconds, int egvInfoBitmask, int interval, int egvCount) {
038        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, glucoseValueStatusRaw, cgmDataTypeRaw, rate, algorithmState, rssi, currentGlucoseDisplayValue, timeStampSeconds, egvInfoBitmask, interval, egvCount);
039        parse(cargo);
040        
041    }
042
043    /**
044     * Builds a record with {@code egvCount} = 1, the value a five-minute reading with no missed
045     * readings carries.
046     */
047    public DexcomG6CGMHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int glucoseValueStatusRaw, int cgmDataTypeRaw, int rate, int algorithmState, int rssi, int currentGlucoseDisplayValue, long timeStampSeconds, int egvInfoBitmask, int interval) {
048        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, glucoseValueStatusRaw, cgmDataTypeRaw, rate, algorithmState, rssi, currentGlucoseDisplayValue, timeStampSeconds, egvInfoBitmask, interval, 1);
049    }
050
051    public int typeId() {
052        return 256;
053    }
054
055    /**
056     * <table border="1">
057     * <caption>Parsed fields for DexcomG6CGMHistoryLog:</caption>
058     * <tr><td><code>glucoseValueStatusRaw</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
059     * <tr><td><code>glucoseValueStatus</code></td><td><code>getGlucoseValueStatus()</code></td></tr>
060     * <tr><td><code>cgmDataTypeRaw</code></td><td><code>raw[12]</code></td></tr>
061     * <tr><td><code>cgmDataTypes</code></td><td><code>getCgmDataTypes()</code></td></tr>
062     * <tr><td><code>rate</code></td><td><code>raw[13]</code></td></tr>
063     * <tr><td><code>algorithmState</code></td><td><code>raw[14]</code></td></tr>
064     * <tr><td><code>rssi</code></td><td><code>raw[15]</code></td></tr>
065     * <tr><td><code>currentGlucoseDisplayValue</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 16)</code></td></tr>
066     * <tr><td><code>timeStampSeconds</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
067     * <tr><td><code>egvInfoBitmaskRaw</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 22)</code></td></tr>
068     * <tr><td><code>egvInfo</code></td><td><code>getEgvInfo()</code></td></tr>
069     * <tr><td><code>interval</code></td><td><code>raw[24]</code></td></tr>
070     * <tr><td><code>egvCount</code></td><td><code>raw[25] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
071     * </table>
072     */
073    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
074        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
075        this.cargo = raw;
076        parseBase(raw);
077        this.glucoseValueStatusRaw = Bytes.readShort(raw, 10);
078        this.glucoseValueStatus = getGlucoseValueStatus();
079        this.cgmDataTypeRaw = raw[12];
080        this.cgmDataTypes = getCgmDataTypes();
081        this.rate = raw[13];
082        this.algorithmState = raw[14];
083        this.rssi = raw[15];
084        this.currentGlucoseDisplayValue = Bytes.readShort(raw, 16);
085        this.timeStampSeconds = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 18);
086        this.egvInfoBitmaskRaw = Bytes.readShort(raw, 22);
087        this.egvInfo = getEgvInfo();
088        this.interval = raw[24];
089        this.egvCount = raw[25] & 0xFF;
090        
091    }
092
093    /**
094     * Builds a record with {@code egvCount} = 1, the value a five-minute reading with no missed
095     * readings carries.
096     */
097    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int glucoseValueStatus, int cgmDataType, int rate, int algorithmState, int rssi, int currentGlucoseDisplayValue, long timeStampSeconds, int egvInfoBitmask, int interval) {
098        return buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, glucoseValueStatus, cgmDataType, rate, algorithmState, rssi, currentGlucoseDisplayValue, timeStampSeconds, egvInfoBitmask, interval, 1);
099    }
100
101    /**
102     * <table border="1">
103     * <caption>Byte layout for DexcomG6CGMHistoryLog.buildCargo(...):</caption>
104     * <tr><th>Offset</th><th>Description</th></tr>
105     * <tr><td>0</td><td><code>toUint32(pumpTimeSec) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
106     * <tr><td>1</td><td><code>toUint32(pumpTimeSec) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
107     * <tr><td>2</td><td><code>toUint32(pumpTimeSec) [byte 2]</code></td></tr>
108     * <tr><td>3</td><td><code>toUint32(pumpTimeSec) [byte 3]</code></td></tr>
109     * <tr><td>4</td><td><code>toUint32(sequenceNum) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
110     * <tr><td>5</td><td><code>toUint32(sequenceNum) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
111     * <tr><td>6</td><td><code>toUint32(sequenceNum) [byte 2]</code></td></tr>
112     * <tr><td>7</td><td><code>toUint32(sequenceNum) [byte 3]</code></td></tr>
113     * <tr><td>8</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(glucoseValueStatus) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
114     * <tr><td>9</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(glucoseValueStatus) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
115     * <tr><td>10</td><td><code>(byte) cgmDataType</code></td></tr>
116     * <tr><td>11</td><td><code>(byte) rate</code></td></tr>
117     * <tr><td>12</td><td><code>(byte) algorithmState</code></td></tr>
118     * <tr><td>13</td><td><code>(byte) rssi</code></td></tr>
119     * <tr><td>14</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(currentGlucoseDisplayValue) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
120     * <tr><td>15</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(currentGlucoseDisplayValue) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
121     * <tr><td>16</td><td><code>toUint32(timeStampSeconds) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
122     * <tr><td>17</td><td><code>toUint32(timeStampSeconds) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
123     * <tr><td>18</td><td><code>toUint32(timeStampSeconds) [byte 2]</code></td></tr>
124     * <tr><td>19</td><td><code>toUint32(timeStampSeconds) [byte 3]</code></td></tr>
125     * <tr><td>20</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(egvInfoBitmask) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
126     * <tr><td>21</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(egvInfoBitmask) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
127     * <tr><td>22</td><td><code>(byte) interval</code></td></tr>
128     * <tr><td>23</td><td><code>(byte) egvCount</code></td></tr>
129     * </table>
130     */
131    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int glucoseValueStatus, int cgmDataType, int rate, int algorithmState, int rssi, int currentGlucoseDisplayValue, long timeStampSeconds, int egvInfoBitmask, int interval, int egvCount) {
132        return Bytes.combine(
133            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(256, 0),
134            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
135            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
136            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(glucoseValueStatus), 
137            new byte[]{ (byte) cgmDataType }, 
138            new byte[]{ (byte) rate }, 
139            new byte[]{ (byte) algorithmState }, 
140            new byte[]{ (byte) rssi }, 
141            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(currentGlucoseDisplayValue), 
142            Bytes.toUint32(timeStampSeconds), 
143            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(egvInfoBitmask), 
144            new byte[]{ (byte) interval },
145            new byte[]{ (byte) egvCount });
146    }
147    
148    public int getGlucoseValueStatusRaw() {
149        return glucoseValueStatusRaw;
150    }
151
152    public enum GlucoseValueStatus {
153        PRECISE_VALUE(0),
154        SPECIAL_HIGH(1),
155        SPECIAL_LOW(2),
156        DO_NOT_SHOW(6)
157
158        ;
159        private int id;
160        GlucoseValueStatus(int id) {
161            this.id = id;
162        }
163
164        public static GlucoseValueStatus fromId(int id) {
165            for (GlucoseValueStatus r : values()) {
166                if (r.id == id) {
167                    return r;
168                }
169            }
170            return null;
171        }
172
173        public int getId() {
174            return id;
175        }
176    }
177
178    public GlucoseValueStatus getGlucoseValueStatus() {
179        return GlucoseValueStatus.fromId(glucoseValueStatusRaw);
180    }
181
182    public int getCgmDataTypeRaw() {
183        return cgmDataTypeRaw;
184    }
185
186    public enum CgmDataType {
187        FIVE_MINUTE_READING(1),
188        BACKFILL(2),
189        IMMEDIATE_MATCH_VALUE(4),
190        CALIBRATION(8),
191        NONE(16)
192
193        ;
194        private int id;
195        CgmDataType(int id) {
196            this.id = id;
197        }
198
199        public static Set<CgmDataType> fromId(int mask) {
200            Set<CgmDataType> items = new TreeSet<>();
201            for (CgmDataType i : values()) {
202                if ((mask & i.getId()) != 0) {
203                    items.add(i);
204                }
205            }
206
207            return items;
208        }
209
210        public int getId() {
211            return id;
212        }
213    }
214
215    public Set<CgmDataType> getCgmDataTypes() {
216        return CgmDataType.fromId(cgmDataTypeRaw);
217    }

280
281    /**
282     * Bits 11-13 of {@code egvInfoBitmask}: the CGM sensor type. Tandem's FSL3 schema (opcode 480)
283     * names these bits "Sensor Type"; in captures they are 1 (G6) in 256 records from 2023 on, 3
284     * (G7) in 399 records, and 0 on 2022 firmware.
285     */
286    public CgmStatusV2Response.CgmSensorType getEgvSensorType() {
287        return getEgvSensorType(egvInfoBitmaskRaw);
288    }
289
290    static CgmStatusV2Response.CgmSensorType getEgvSensorType(int egvInfoBitmask) {
291        return CgmStatusV2Response.CgmSensorType.fromId((egvInfoBitmask >> 11) & 0x7);
292    }
293
294    public int getInterval() {
295        return interval;
296    }
297
298    /**
299     * Byte 25, which Tandem's schema leaves unnamed. It is 0 in backfill records. In a five-minute
300     * reading it is the number of readings the record covers: 1 normally, or N after N-1 missed
301     * readings, whose backfill records the pump logs right after it. The meaning is inferred from
302     * captures (see pumpX2#76); newer Mobi firmware has been seen writing 0 here for five-minute
303     * readings too.
304     */
305    public int getEgvCount() {
306        return egvCount;
307    }
